title: iskeyword
summary: Test MATLAB reserved keywords or list all keywords.

gpu_support.notes: Host text/language predicate. gpuArray inputs are invalid because the input must be text.

description: `iskeyword(s)` returns true when `s` is a MATLAB reserved keyword. `iskeyword` with no inputs returns a cell column containing the full keyword list as character vectors.
behaviors: Accepts a string scalar or character vector for the predicate form.
Rejects non-text inputs and nonscalar string arrays.
The keyword list is shared with `isvarname`, so reserved words such as `for`, `end`, `classdef`, and `parfor` cannot be valid variable names.
The result of `iskeyword(s)` is a host logical scalar. The result of `iskeyword` is a cell column of character row vectors.

faqs.question: Does `iskeyword` accept string arrays?
faqs.answer: Only string scalars are accepted. Multi-element string arrays are rejected so the predicate remains a scalar MATLAB-compatible query.

faqs.question: Is the comparison case-sensitive?
faqs.answer: Yes. MATLAB keywords are lowercase language tokens, so `iskeyword('for')` is true while `iskeyword('For')` is false.
